referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the basic structure of the kitchen cupboards and the front cover (solid wood) per m3. The inventory bases on a kitchen with a cupboard volume of 3.36 m3. Screws and hinges are considered proportionally. The countertop, sink, waste system and cooker hood are not included. Linked to updated LCI of three layered laminated boards from Ecoinvent data v3.2 for KBOB recommendation 2016.; Geography: Data valid for Switzerland
